subject: MSA / Order Form: redlines, pricing ladder, min-commit schedule & tax routing
messages:
From: Ava Gold <ava.gold@harbourtech.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@harbourtech.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Draft Order Form + a couple of open commercial items

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — HarbourTech is excited to move forward. Attached is the draft Order Form for signature (HarbourTech_Draft_OrderForm_20250612.pdf). Legal had a quick pass and flagged three commercial items we need to lock before exec sign-off:

- Pricing ladder: we want the second-tier discount to trigger at $150k rather than $200k.
- Minimum commitment phasing: can we do a 6+6 ramp (first 6 months 60% of commit, next 6 months remaining) rather than full-year up front?
- Net terms & invoice routing: finance asks if Redwood can accept Net45 and send invoices to procurement@harbourtech.com; they also asked about VAT handling for international usage.

Can you confirm Redwood's position so we can hand this to our GC? If helpful, we can do a short call tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Gold
Head of Procurement, HarbourTech
ava.gold@harbourtech.com
Attachment: HarbourTech_Draft_OrderForm_20250612.pdf (application/pdf, 248 KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ava Gold <ava.gold@harbourtech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft Order Form + a couple of open commercial items

Hi Ava — appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear list. Short answers and next steps below.

- Pricing ladder: we can move the second-tier trigger to $150k, but it will require a small change to the pricing appendix; Ben can confirm the exact $/token bands.
- Min-commit phasing: we normally structure minimum commits on annual cadence, but we have flexibility for a 6+6 ramp for new pilots — we will mark this as an Order Form appendix and tie invoicing to the phased schedule.
- Net terms & invoices: our standard for new enterprise deals is Net30; Net45 is not standard but not a deal-breaker — it will require finance approval. For invoicing, we can send invoices to procurement@harbourtech.com.
- VAT/residency: we will need HarbourTech’s tax residency certificate and a point-of-contact for EU usage to determine reverse-charge applicability.

Action items I propose:
1) I will send an annotated notes file with the proposed language changes (attached).
2) Kimberley/Ben — can legal/finance produce redline language and a short comment bundle by EOD Friday? Our legal lead is Jonas Weber; I’ve copied him in the follow-up.
3) Ava — please confirm the procurement PO contact and whether HarbourTech can provide a tax residency cert (or VAT ID) for EU reverse-charge.

If those are all OK, we can book a 30-min alignment call Monday to confirm signatures and the first invoice milestone.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Attachment: Evelyn_OrderForm_annotated_notes.txt (text/plain, 3 KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft Order Form - legal redlines + suggested contract language

Eve / Ben — looping in legal (Jonas) with our suggested redlines so we can turn this around quickly. High-level guidance below and a note on timing.

Commercial redline suggestions (draft language to include in the Order Form appendix):
1) Pricing ladder: replace the second-tier threshold with "$150,000 aggregate committed spend during the Term" and add an example row in the pricing table to show effective unit pricing.
2) Minimum commitment ramp: add clause: "Customer may elect a phased Minimum Commitment over the first 12 months as follows: 60% due in Months 1–6, 40% due in Months 7–12. Invoicing shall be issued pro rata at each milestone." This preserves revenue recognition clarity.
3) Net terms: propose to accept Net45 for this account on the condition of an approval memo from Finance; add a sentence: "Invoices due Net45 for the initial Term for HarbourTech, Finance approval documented in Deal Sheet DL-2025-0578."
4) Tax & VAT: add a responsibility clause: "Customer responsible for VAT/GST unless a valid reverse-charge or tax exemption certificate is provided prior to the first invoice. Customer will provide documentation within 10 business days of signature."

Timing & process:
- Legal can produce a tracked redline of the MSA + Order Form by EOD Friday (13 Jun). Jonas — can you confirm?
- Finance (Ben) to confirm the revenue recognition language and sign-off on Net45 by close of business Monday.
- Eve — if HarbourTech confirms the PO contact and can provide VAT ID, we’ll include that in the DocuSign metadata.

Attachment: Legal_redline_guidance.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 22 KB)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Gold <ava.gold@harbourtech.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form: redlines, pricing ladder, min-commit schedule & tax routing

Hi all — quick update from finance side. We can provisionally accept Net45 for HarbourTech provided the following are captured before first invoice:

- Deal sheet signed confirming Net45 (DL-2025-0578).
- PO issued to procurement@harbourtech.com at or prior to signature.
- HarbourTech provides VAT ID / tax residency evidence for any EU usage within 10 business days of signature.

I’ve approved the pricing ladder change to $150k and the phased minimum commit language recommended by Kimberly. Jonas — please circulate the tracked redline when ready and I’ll confirm final revenue recognition text.

Proposed next steps (short timeline):
- Fri 13 Jun (EOD): Legal redline delivered.
- Mon 16 Jun (AM): HarbourTech confirms PO contact + sends VAT ID (if applicable).
- Mon 16 Jun (PM): 30-min sign-off call, finalize DocuSign envelope.
- Tue 17 Jun: Send first invoice per phased schedule (if signature complete and PO on file).

Ava — if that timeline works we’ll treat Net45 as approved and move the contract to signature.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
